title: Nectar requests skip the queue
summary:
A day of request-path work: Nectar queue bypass, more reusable text caching, and stage-based GPT Image routing.

Queue handling now accounts for authentication and user tier. Nectar-tier requests bypass the queue whether authenticated by token or registered referrer; other token-authenticated requests enter with no queue interval. Referrer validation was added, and GPT Image access now checks authentication directly rather than using queue bypass as a proxy.

Text cache keys now ignore authentication and request-control fields, so otherwise identical requests can use the same cached result instead of creating separate entries.

GPT Image requests now select an endpoint by user stage instead of at random: Seed uses one endpoint, while Flower and Nectar use another. Failed Turbo and Flux fetches now return an error immediately rather than retrying.
